units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 6:11">Targ. Deut. VI, 11</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="Q01286"><he>פְּסִיל</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="Q01287"><he>פְּסִילָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>פְּסִילִין</he>; <cite ref="Q01287"><he>פְּסִילָן</he></cite>, <he>פְּסִל׳</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 23a:9">Snh. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>בתר דפַסְלֵי להו וכ׳</he> after they (the parties) rejected them, shall they (the rejected judges) go and select another court? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 23a:26">Ib.</cite> <he>רחמנא פַסְלֵיה</he> it is the Law that declared him unfit.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 23a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>כל כמיניה דפָסֵיל דייני</he> is it in his power to reject judges?; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 22:10">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXII, 10</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 7:18">Targ. Y. I Lev. VII, 18</cite> (Y. II <cite ref="Q01241"><he>פָּסוּל</he></cite> h. form; h. text <he>פגול</he>); a. e.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:27">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 27</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01287"><he>פְּסִילָא</he></cite>.]—
<cite ref="Ketubot 61b:1">Keth. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן דעביד הכי פ׳ למאכל וכ׳</he> he who does a thing like this is unfit to prepare food for the king.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:3">Ib. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>האי דיינא … פ׳ למידן דינא</he> (some ed. <he>פסול</he>) a judge that is in the habit of borrowing (things from his neighbors) is unfit to judge cases.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>פְּסִילְנָא לך לדינא</he> I am unfit to be a judge in thy case (because I have been offered a gift); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="Q01239"><he>פְּסוֹל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 19:24">Targ. Job XIX, 24</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 51:1">Targ. Is. LI, 1</cite>.
Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 16. [Targ. Y. Num. VIII, 24 מוּפְסָלִין h. Hof.]—Y. Kil. VII, 31ᵃ top [read:] א״ל טבא היא ואִיפְסְלַת he said to him, it is a good coin, whereas it had been cancelled.

<cite ref="Menachot 102b:7">Men. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>לאִיפְּסוּלֵי דגופיה</he> (Ms. M. <he>לפסולא</he>) to become unfit for itself (but not for making unclean); <cite ref="Pesachim 20a:5">Pes. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>לאיפסולי גופיה</he>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Chullin 36a:12">Ḥull. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>לאַפְסוּלֵי גופיה</he> to cause the object itself to be forbidden (<cite ref="Chullin 37a:1">ib. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>לפסולא דגופיה</he>), v. supra.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 24:12">Targ. II Chr. XXIV, 12</cite> <he>מְפַסְּלִין</he> stone-cutters.
